propositions: The backtest script's --check-planning-corpus mode asserts PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE=113 against a derivation re-run from live ticket state, causing false failures when historical tickets are reclassified or prefix resolution changes.

The corpus is documented as 'pinned and reproducible' but is not identity-pinned; it drifts when bug-type classifications or ticket prefixes change (corpus measured at 114 on live tracker vs. expected 113).
The fix replaces the count-based constant with PLANNING_CORPUS_COMMITS, a frozenset of the 113 exact commit SHAs adjudicated at the pin point, eliminating sensitivity to tracker churn.
Check mode now iterates pinned SHAs directly and validates identity and flagged-set membership rather than re-deriving from live ticket state.
The docstring is updated to reflect that the corpus is pinned by identity; per-row labels remain best-effort artifact metadata and no longer gate validation.
